verdict.rationale: A built-in knowledge base or RAG is a fair axis for a voice-agent platform, but nothing in the evidence documents document upload, retrieval, or grounding. Function calling ([deepgram-docs-2], [deepgram-docs-20]) only lets the developer's own application run actions, which would mean building retrieval yourself rather than using a built-in capability. The conversation-context and prompting docs cover call context and system prompts, not grounding on documents.
